zh: 排序关键字是二级的：先比较这个编号在整个数组中出现的次数，再比较编号本身；重复的编号都要保留。
先统计每个编号的出现次数，之后每个元素的排序键 (频次, 编号) 就固定了，直接按这个键对原数组排序即可。
编号不超过 10⁶，可以用数组计数；然后按 (counts[v], v) 升序排序（也可以把两者打包成一个 64 位整数再排序）；最后用空格连接输出全部 n 个编号，大量输出时注意用缓冲。
en: The sort key has two levels: first how many times the ID occurs in the whole array, then the ID itself; duplicate IDs are all kept.
Count the occurrences of each ID first; after that every element has a fixed key (frequency, ID), so simply sort the original array by that key.

IDs are at most 10^6, so an array works for counting; then sort ascending by (counts[v], v) (or pack both into one 64-bit integer and sort that); finally print all n IDs separated by spaces, using buffered output for the large output.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the frequencies first, then sort the original array by (frequency, ID).

## Proof of correctness

Every value has a fixed sort key that matches the two-level ordering of the problem; a comparison sort makes every pair of adjacent items in the output satisfy the requirement, and it only reorders elements without adding or removing any.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
